title: llama.cpp b11718：恢复 ESIMD 内核至 FFN 路径，扩展 Q8_0 融合优化
summary: llama.cpp 凌晨 push 了 b11718，恢复 FFN 路径上的 ESIMD 内核并将融合范围扩展至 Q8_0 量化，在 Intel 硬件上实现更高效的推理性能。
summary_en: llama.cpp release b11718 restores ESIMD kernels on the FFN path and extends ESIMD fusion to include Q8_0 quantization, improving inference efficiency on Intel hardware. The commit also re-enables ESIMD on the FFN path and removes an obsolete comment in test-backend-ops. Signed by Todd Malsbary (Intel).
body:
llama.cpp 凌晨 push 了 b11718，恢复 FFN 路径上的 ESIMD 内核并将融合范围扩展至 Q8_0 量化，在 Intel 硬件上实现更高效的推理性能。
